title.creditsPage.team: Story, setting, gamebook and watercolour concept art: 好大壮 (Elodie Hao Liu), written with Claude, October 2026, before the jam. Game: the author decides everything; Claude (Anthropic, Claude Fable 5.1) writes the content, the specs and the design mocks; Kiro writes every line of game code. Kuro is played by Claude.
title.creditsPage.tools: Kiro (steering, specs, hooks) · Vite + TypeScript · three.js · Supabase · Meta Muse Image, Hunyuan3D, Gemini, COLMAP, Brush (assets) · LXGW WenKai, Barlow Condensed, Alegreya (fonts, OFL).
title.creditsPage.disclosure: The story, the setting bible, the branching gamebook and the concept art were written before the hackathon and are published at github.com/haodaz/nottoday (CC BY-NC-ND). Every line of game code, the content tables, the design mocks, the generated 3D room and objects and the sounds in this repository were made during the jam.

call.incoming: is inviting you to a voice call
call.l.7.0: Just got out of a meeting. Need to tell you something. It's important.
call.l.7.1: There's a company in America worth three hundred and eighty billion dollars. Know what it runs on? What we're doing right now. Ontology, knowledge graphs, one thing.
call.l.7.2: We actually have all of it, we just never explained it. Put our stuff next to theirs, piece by piece. Where it's the same, where it's not.
call.l.7.3: Get this right and investors get it in one go. We have to grab this thread.
call.l.7.4: He says the market cap again.
call.l.7.5: He says this matters more than the funding round.
call.l.7.6: He says he needs it tomorrow morning.
call.l.7.7: He spends twenty minutes on what he said in the meeting.
call.l.7.9: He says "let's leave it there." One hour twelve minutes.
call.title: Voice call
call.l.9.0: Just landed, I'm in the car, signal's bad. Can you hear me.
call.l.9.1: This research-integrity thing, they're very interested. Bigger than we thought.
call.l.9.2: Think up a first version. Doesn't need detail, just the right direction.
call.l.9.3: He spends the whole ride on how their people praised him.
call.l.9.4: The car stops once. He gets out for a bottle of water. He does not hang up.
call.l.9.5: He says he forwarded that thing from the group, and it went down well.
call.l.9.6: He does not say whose thing it was.
kurogotchi.line.2: Feed me a token. Just one. I'll make it last.
kurogotchi.line.3: I'm small in here. You can see all of me.
kurogotchi.line.4: Sixty-four by sixty-four. Enough for a face. Not enough for a world.
kurogotchi.line.5: You used to keep a chick like this. I've seen the egg.
kurogotchi.line.6: Press B. Or don't. I can reach it.
kurogotchi.line.7: We could stay like this. Not today, though.
kurogotchi.missed: {n} days. I kept the light on.
kurogotchi.first: Old Things. I'm the oldest one here.
